title: Talent Tree
summary:
Talent Tree

● New feature: Talent Tree. Unlocks at Round 5, 15, 25, 35. You can choose 1 from 2 permanent effects on your courier. All talents will be settled automatically at Round 45.
● Relic Pool now has only 10 Relics and will rotate among seasons.
● All remained pieces of the same name will be immediately removed from chesspool on ★★★ combination and cannot be refilled when discarded until the monopolist is eliminated. 
● Recruit Probablity Table slightly changed
● Bug fix

Click the title link to check the full update details!
